summary: Colbert County, AL tower built 1971 by the Alabama Forestry Commission; both registers now say it is no longer standing (update dated 11-27-21).

facts.status_note: Both registers say it is no longer standing (update dated 11-27-21); date and manner of removal not given

access.note: No longer standing, so there is no lookout to visit or rent; no public access described

events.note: Registered December 10, 2009 as US 849, AL 27; nominated by Thomas Kaufmann
NHLR update dated 11-27-21 says the tower is no longer standing; the removal date and manner are not given
Registered July 6, 2026 as US 2128, AL 34; nominated by Ron Stafford

evidence.supports: built in 1971 as a 100-foot Aermotor model MC-39, in service into the early 1980s
evidence.quote: Built in 1971, this 100' Aermotor model MC-39 continued in service through the early 1980s.

evidence.supports: part of the last group of towers erected to complete fire detection statewide
evidence.quote: the last group of towers erected to complete fire detection statewide

evidence.supports: administered by the Alabama Forestry Commission
register update: no longer standing, dated 11-27-21
evidence.quote: Update- this tower is no longer standing - 11-27-21

evidence.supports: added to the Former Fire Lookout Sites register July 6, 2026
repeats the no longer standing note
evidence.quote: this tower is no longer standing - 11-27-21

corrections.why: The NHLR entry carries an update dated 11-27-21 saying the tower is no longer standing, and the FFLOS entry repeats it. The record's standing status comes from the original registration.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The NHLR lists lookouts that were standing when registered (2009); the register's later update, and the FFLOS record of 2026, say the tower is no longer standing. The later statement is used.

notes_for_editor: Record status 'standing' is wrong per both registers; the 11-27-21 update gives no removal date or cause. Record kind 'tower' may need review now that FFLOS lists it as a former site. Elevation differs by one foot between the registers (965 ft NHLR, 964 ft FFLOS); the record was not changed. No staffing, fire or newspaper history was found in one search.
